input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Admin, Content Creator roles. The platform provides capabilities for click me callback update handler, throw exception callback update handler, callback command update handler. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include messaging functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Admin, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Admin, I want to receive notifications about important events, so that I can stay informed and respond promptly.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a Admin, I want to upload and manage files, so that I can store and retrieve documents when needed.
As a Admin, I want to interact with default webhook functionality, so that I can accomplish my default webhook-related tasks.
